title: The Amusement Park Bungee Jumping Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast (Conan, Kogoro, Ran, Inspector Megure, Officer Takagi) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: actions are direct typed edges. This case is unusually rich in red herrings: three of the four other troupe members each carry a distinct, transcript-stated grudge against the victim (management dispute, debt/fear, an unpaid story-rights bribe), and the rigger Ishijima is accused purely on physical opportunity with no motive ever stated for him -- kept motive-free per the honesty rule rather than inventing one. case_type: murder.

attrs.note: attached the bungee cord to Yaiba's feet before every jump, giving him unique physical access to the ring; accused first on opportunity alone, no motive against Hosono is stated anywhere in the transcript

attrs.died_of: drowned before the show, in a location separate from where his death was staged to look like it happened

attrs.note: recognized from prior shows that this performance's Yaiba moved differently, detonated the stage explosion at the wrong moment, and struck an unfamiliar final pose

locations.name: Nichiuri Land amusement park -- Kamen Yaiba show stage and bungee jump platform

attrs.significance: where Hosono's body was found; also where the culprit surfaced and swam to escape after detonating the ring
held two Kamen Yaiba costumes; the spare one, used by the culprit, later had one piece found wet

locations.name: Power center (approx. 100m from the bungee platform)

attrs.significance: underwater exit point the culprit swam to using a compact regulator before changing into dry clothes and rejoining the crowd

objects.name: Explosives hidden in the bungee-cord ring

attrs.staging_flaw: the rubber ring's break marks were charred black, which a normal mechanical failure would not produce -- the first clue that the fall was not an accident

attrs.mechanism: activated by a hand/fist clench mid-fall, timed to sever the cord while underwater cover was available

attrs.staging_flaw: one piece of the spare costume was found wet, unlike Hosono's original costume, proving whoever wore it during the performance had already been in the water beforehand

attrs.capability: allowed roughly ten minutes underwater, enough to swim the ~100 meters from the platform to the power center unseen

objects.name: Spectator's video recording of the jump

attrs.content: shows Yaiba touching the ring just before the jump, his left hand open and right hand clenched in a fist during the fall, and a puff of smoke consistent with an explosive charge, not a mechanical cord failure

clues.desc: Video pose-asymmetry clue: footage of the fall shows the performer's left hand open and right hand clenched in a fist, a pose no one recognizes from any official Kamen Yaiba pose -- consistent with the right hand gripping a detonator rather than performing a stunt.

Performance-deviation clue (Tomohiro's testimony comparing this show to every prior one he'd watched): the stage explosion triggered early, on the 'hand on waist' beat instead of after the usual 'Yaiba!' call, and the closing pose used a fully closed fist instead of Hosono's signature index-finger-to-the-sky pose -- both consistent with a substitute performer secretly timing detonations to his own body rather than the choreography.

Costume-wetness clue: of the two Kamen Yaiba costumes in the dressing room, only the spare one had a wet piece, proving whoever wore it during the show had already been in the water -- i.e. had already drowned Hosono and swapped costumes before the act began.

edges.method: found Hosono alone backstage and made him faint

edges.detail: moved Hosono's unconscious body, still in his original Kamen Yaiba costume, to the river and drowned him before the show began
changed into the spare Kamen Yaiba costume and took over Hosono's role in the live show
attached the explosive charge to the bungee-cord ring while appearing to check it, in view of the crowd but disguised as routine

edges.method: triggered the body-worn detonator with a clenched right hand mid-fall, severing the cord to fake a fatal accident

edges.detail: swam underwater from the platform to the power center to escape unseen
changed into dry clothes and rejoined the spectators

edges.motive_type: jealousy_and_humiliation (Hosono told him he lacked the authority/willpower to ever play Kamen Yaiba and treated him like a servant)
management_dispute (red herring; conflict over Hosono's handling/management of the troupe)
debt_and_fear (red herring; owed Hosono money and felt cornered/intimidated by him)
unpaid_bribe (red herring; Hosono used Fujita's story idea for the show and promised him a cut of the profits but never paid)
